Drums are real recordings: a kit played with sticks at Virtuosity Musical Instruments in Boston, captured with kick, snare, overhead and room mics, from the free Virtuosity Drums library by Versilian Studios (CC0). The kick and toms are tuned slightly lower and lightly dampened, the way a rock drummer would set them up. Every hit picks from several velocity layers and alternate strikes, and the timing drifts a few milliseconds like a human player.
